identity.name: StarCoder2
identity.summary: StarCoder2-15B is a 15-billion-parameter model trained on more than 600 programming languages using The Stack v2, with opt-out requests excluded.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card states training data is The Stack v2 with opt-out requests excluded, plus GitHub code and selected sources such as Arxiv and Wikipedia, but provides no standardized verification of data origin or usage terms.

possible_risks.description: Terms of service, license compliance, or other IP issues may restrict the ability to use certain data for building models.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight model trained on GitHub code and other web sources; the card does not document license compliance or terms-of-service restrictions for those sources.

possible_risks.description: A model might generate content that is similar or identical to existing work protected by copyright or covered by open-source license agreement.
possible_risks.justification: Trained on 600+ programming languages from The Stack v2 and GitHub code, so it may generate code similar to existing copyrighted or open-source licensed works.

possible_risks.description: Models might generate code that causes harm or unintentionally affects other systems.
possible_risks.justification: Text-generation model trained on a large corpus of code with no reported safety evaluation, so it can plausibly generate code that causes harm or affects systems.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card names broad sources (The Stack v2, GitHub, Arxiv, Wikipedia) but does not document dataset details or filtering beyond opt-out requests.

specifications.model_size: 59.4 GiB of safetensors weights (63,831,628,056 bytes) in F32

training_context.training_data: The StarCoder2-15B checkpoint was trained on The Stack v2, covering 600+ programming languages with opt-out requests excluded, plus GitHub code and additional selected sources such as Arxiv and Wikipedia.
